title: A transcription firm used by police, prosecutors and tech giants exposed customer data online | TechCrunch
summary: A transcription company that caters to law enforcement, government departments, and Silicon Valley tech giants has resolved a security lapse after leaving a large amount of internal data, including customer transcriptions and their source materials, exposed to the web.
